title: Black Friday 2026: the best credit card offers and travel deals to earn more points
body:
Black Friday is officially Friday 27 November in 2026, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. But plenty of brands aren’t waiting. Lenovo started its early Black Friday sale in October, Flight Centre launched its sale on 9 November, and more retailers usually join in through the second half of the month.
Some of these deals are genuinely worth grabbing, like a flight you were going to book anyway or the appliance you’ve been putting off replacing. We’d never suggest spending more than you planned. But if those purchases are happening anyway, putting them on a new credit card can help you reach the minimum spend for a sign-up bonus, which turns your Christmas shopping into points for your next trip.
Here are the current sign-up offers worth pairing with the sales, how to use the sales to reach the bonus, and the travel deals that make it even better value.
